    Profile

    Found dying from his own overwhelming Alchemic power in a slum, Li Wang was picked up by Projekt Goetia as a guinea pig for their bonding experiments. Having survived the ordeal, he saw it as an opportunity to climb the social ladder, not wanting to live another day poor and weak. His tenacious efforts paid off when he was named Finance Marshal for the organization, as well as the Head of the Greed Dike branch. However, Li Wang's ambitions do not end there; he will not be satisfied until he takes over the Director's seat.

    Origin: Greed Dike
    Gender: Male
    Height: 157cm
    Weight: 48kg
    Birthday: Sep 23
    Blood Type: Type Kn
    Zodiac: Moon of the Ice Water Wolf
    Likes: Money, Power, Status
    Hobbies: Attending or holding lavish parties.
    Illust: gumi Asia
    CV: 小倉弥優
